key.name: tickers-json
key.description: JSON-encoded ticker list. An empty value falls back to the built-in defaults.

key.name: refresh-interval-seconds
key.description: Default polling cadence in seconds before market-aware throttling is applied.

key.name: show-price
key.description: Whether to include the quote price in the panel.

key.name: show-arrow
key.description: Whether to include the directional arrow for percent change.

key.name: show-percent
key.description: Whether to include the percent change text in the panel.

key.name: separator-style
key.description: Default separator shown between ticker entries when no ticker-specific separator override exists.

key.name: font-preset
key.description: Curated font preset used for ticker text in the panel. Preset font families fall back through the system if unavailable.
